goal: Distinguish an actual known larval host plant signal from historical climate variation found in currently climate-matched plants not recorded as hosts for that insect.

source.cohort: all 348 previously qualified disjoint-split reference insect species; 335 with every known accepted host ID represented

design.stage1: Match alternate plant taxon identities using 0 BP CHELSA ONLY, freeze source-bound matched ID sets and modern mismatch before computing any LGM score.
design.actual_host: Use each insect's actual v0.2 WCVP accepted host identities and modern source observations, 50-km uncertainty-buffer from insect original localities and five internal edge evaluation points, within-species 10-km thinning, cap200.
design.alternate_pool: Other successfully sampled WCVP accepted plant taxa, excluding any taxon recorded as a host for that insect AND every plant with the same genus as any actual known host; non-listed does not prove not a real host.
design.preselection: Deterministic SHA256 priority restrict max64 observations per alternate plant for 0 BP four-var climate signatures; require >=30 raw modern observations and >=30 after per-insect 50km exclusion and 10km thinning.
design.moment_match: For each insect compare candidate plant centroid + per-var SD standardized present (0 BP) climate with actual selected modern host cloud. Rank by Euclidean four-var mean distance plus 0.5 times SD distance. No LGM, genetics, evolutionary source metadata or host null effect used.
design.selection: Use the first 16 eligible distinct alternate plant taxa, sorted by distance score; form eight nonoverlapping alternate taxon-ID groups of size min(number known host taxa,3), with each group made from consecutive sorted alternatives. If fewer than 8 groups exist, record fixed number and do not supplement via post-LGM score. Each group re-filtered as an insect-specific combined cloud.
design.min_requirements: At least four fully viable alternate groups with >=30 selected 50-km-separated observations, >=60 insect observation points and >=30 actual host observations; otherwise label not evaluable. No salvage of species from v0.4 outside 348 list.
design.replicates: Eight deterministic disjoint insect-self splits per viable species paired with up to eight fixed plant-alternate groups. All reference cloud counts per comparison equal to k=min(100,floor(n_insect/2),n_actual_host,n_alternative_group), with k>=30.
design.metric: For each pair calculate historical host-minus-modern nearest climate distance per original edge. Residualize to self LGM change, both present-mismatch distances and log1p endpoint geographic distance, as in v0.4. Report actual-minus-alternate *fraction* and *raw residual variance* plus modern fit gap.
design.output: source-qualified 348 taxa and 641 disposition rows, matched plant IDs, number viable controls, 0 BP climatic match scores, v0.5 actual/alternate LGM comparison, sensitivity for those with close modern mismatches.
design.analysis_unit: Each insect species; preserve species/genus dependencies. Eight repeated alternative sets and eight reference splits are technical perturbations not biological replicates.

limitations: Pre-registered only within already exploratory post-v0.4 study; not a fresh confirmatory genetic test
Not listed as a HOSTS/WCVP host does not establish biological nonhost status or absence of other interactions
Modern GBIF plant observations are nonrandom and nativity is missing; current climate matching does not prove true ancestral natural niche or ancient distributions
Matching by 0 BP climate mean and SD leaves spatial range shape, geographic history and observational effort possibly unmatched
Different host plant combinations may have different niche breadth even after moment matching
Null and actual historical metrics describe predictor variance, not genetic variation
Original genetic phase NOT_EVALUABLE_EMPIRICAL_RESPONSE remains terminal
Do not report one-sided significance or change thresholds in response to v0.5 scores
